goal: An executable workflow step inspects repository, CI, leases, and evidence before it runs, records the recognized state, and asks or waits instead of guessing the next transition
scenarios: a caller reads a workflow run state snapshot including work item, leases, branches, and evidence
recognizing a ready analyze step allows start and records the snapshot on the step
an exclusive lease held by someone else blocks the step and posts a Team Chat event
a missing approval names request-approval as the next safe action
a stale snapshot after a design change blocks execution
an agent run refuses to start from a blocked recognition
customers cannot recognize workflow step state
constraints: visual workflow designer is out of scope
Workflow Test Lab is out of scope
do not start Phase D chrome on the fused board cockpit
